ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that monitors mempool traffic and automatically coordinates CoinJoin transactions on behalf of users when network fees are optimal.
ideas.title: CoinJoin-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets both the Privacy and AI boss fights by combining automated tooling with surveillance-resistant transaction grouping, fitting the Bitshala focus on deep Bitcoin OSS.

ideas.pitch: A client-side browser extension that allows users to broadcast and receive reusable stealth payment addresses over Nostr relays without exposing their main public identity.
ideas.title: Nostr-Stealth-Pay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Nostr communication primitives with on-chain privacy, aligning perfectly with Bitshala's Cypherpunk and Nostr tracks while solving a genuine metadata leak.

ideas.pitch: A multi-party computation signing tool leveraging Nostr NIP-XX for decentralized, untraceable collaborative transaction approvals among distributed peers.
ideas.title: SilentSign
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a hard engineering problem using the exact decentralized communication layer promoted by the Nostr track, appealing to judges looking for robust OSS primitives.

ideas.pitch: A local Retrieval-Augmented Generation agent trained exclusively on Bitcoin developer documentation, BIPs, and mailing list archives to assist protocol engineers.
ideas.title: Lightning-RAG-Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings high-utility AI directly into the Bitcoin ecosystem, targeting the AI track by saving developer hours and lowering the barrier to entry for protocol contributions.

ideas.pitch: A censorship-resistant data attestation tool that anchors state hashes and fact-checking proofs to Nostr events instead of centralized servers.
ideas.title: Nostr-Witness
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the immutable relay network of Nostr for trustless verification, directly hitting the Nostr track's emphasis on censorship-resistant communication infrastructure.
